relationship: Constructing a gate circuit connects input combinations and Boolean behaviour to a challenge's required output.

learnerLoop.action: Place and wire gates, toggle inputs and check the circuit.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The circuit topology and its signals change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The board, output expression and challenge feedback reveal the circuit's behaviour.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Alter gates or wiring to satisfy the required logic.

invariants: Signals and expressions reflect the circuit currently on the board.
Checking evaluates the learner-built circuit against the active challenge.
safeAdaptations: Change challenge conditions, available gate examples or guidance while retaining editable circuit construction and checking.
nonGoals: Simulating analogue electronics or arbitrary physical circuit layouts.

task.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

controls.description: Gate placement, input switches, full truth-table check and editing actions.
controls.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

model.description: Placed gates and wired ports; port selection supports keyboard as well as dragging.
model.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

evidence.description: Every input combination, intermediate gate values, expression and assessed match.
evidence.visibility: Visible in the corresponding editing, simulation or result state.

inputs.domain: A/B for two-input challenges; A/B/C for secure entry and experiment.

truth.domain: Four or eight input combinations with derived intermediate/output values.

modes.challenge: Two-key safe, workshop fan, secure entry and open experiment.
modes.support: No Working/exam toggle; intermediate gate columns provide evidence.

dependencies: Rack symbols preserve the shapes used by placed gates.
Wiring updates expression and truth rows; editing clears checked feedback.
All target rows must match to pass. Experiment has no target.
Shared hints introduce placement and subsequent wiring; rack, board and truth table retain their purposeful relationship.
implementation.completion: A target challenge passes when the connected circuit matches every input combination.
limitations: Circuit constructions are combinational; cyclic or incomplete wiring cannot produce a complete truth table.
